import csv
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

site = Path('products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example')
trial = Path('products/services/catalogue-one-command-qa')
runner_path = trial / 'run_example.py'
runner = runner_path.read_text()
old = 'subprocess.run([sys.executable, "verify_example.py"], cwd=base)'

if old in runner:
    assert runner.count(old) == 1
    runner = runner.replace(old, new)
else:
    assert runner.count(new) == 1, 'Inspect the current verifier call before editing'

payload = ['transform.py', 'verify.py', 'verify_example.py', 'fixtures/before-variants.csv', 'fixtures/before-images.csv', 'fixtures/after-shopify.csv']
provenance = {name: {'path': str(site / name), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256((site / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for name in payload}
provenance['run_example.py'] = {'path': str(runner_path), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(runner.encode()).hexdigest()}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
    work = Path(temporary)

        shutil.copyfile(site / name, work / name)

    def run(*arguments):
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'run_example.py', *arguments], cwd=work, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        return {'exit_code': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr}

        rows = list(csv.reader(source))

        csv.writer(destination).writerows(rows + [rows[1]])
    duplicate = run('--images', duplicate_fixture.name)
    duplicate_hash = hashlib.sha256(duplicate_fixture.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
